propositions: add_dependency escalates cross-subtree links to nearest common ancestor children but returns the redirect record only via stdout, invisible to library and MCP callers who receive only 'ok'
the quiet=True sink in link_core suppresses the redirect record's stdout emission, making escalation silent to callers that do not read stderr/stdout
three layers in the propagation chain (_link closure, _python_leaf, and rebar.link itself) discard the return value without passing it forward
_python_leaf is shared by all Tier B leaf writes and must return its inner call's value rather than None to preserve the redirect record through the chain

MCP link_tickets tool must report escalation in its string return when resolved endpoints differ from requested ones, following the template: ok (escalated: {source}->{target} recorded as {resolved_source}->{resolved_target})
the fix must preserve quiet=True and the CLI stdout channel to prevent corruption of MCP-over-stdio and protection of other in-process callers
